paper_metadata.title: Portfolio Optimization using Accelerated Quantum Simulation

experiments.description: CUDA Quantum portfolio optimization experiment using a hybrid QAOA/VQE-style variational circuit on real-market stock data, evaluated on CPU versus GPU simulation across portfolio sizes up to 30 assets.

algorithm.variant: QAOA-based variational portfolio optimization implemented in CUDA Quantum and described as VQE with QAOA circuit evolution

problem_formulation.encoding_details: One binary variable per asset inclusion/exclusion; QUBO converted to Ising form for quantum optimization.
problem_formulation.objective_function: H(x) = x^T Q x - λ \sum_i μ_i x_i; cost Hamiltonian also written as H_C = \sum_{i,j} σ_{i,j} Σ_{i,j} - λ \sum_i μ_i σ_i
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Not explicitly specified beyond QUBO formulation; no separate constraint-penalty scheme reported.
problem_formulation.problem_hamiltonian: H(σ) = -\sum_{ij} J_{ij} σ_i σ_j - \sum_i h_i σ_i

problem_instance.description: Portfolio optimization over a diversified set of stocks from multiple sectors using adjusted closing prices and log returns.

dataset_specification.ticker_symbols: Major corporations including AAPL, NKE, CO, and others (full list not provided)
dataset_specification.preprocessing: Adjusted closing prices; logarithmic returns; mean returns and covariance matrix computed; covariance visualized as heatmap

hardware.device_name: CUDA Quantum / cuQuantum on NVIDIA A100 80GB Tensor Core GPU system

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Download adjusted closing prices from Yahoo Finance; compute log returns, mean returns, and covariance matrix.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Compare CPU and GPU execution times; analyze scalability versus asset count.

classical_baselines.value: relatively stable until 15 assets, then dramatic increase

speedup_claims.factor: GPU significantly outperforms CPU; exact factor not reported
speedup_claims.conditions: for portfolio optimization with 15 assets and more
speedup_claims.caveats: No exact runtime values or speedup ratio provided; claim is based on observed execution-time curves in figures.

speedup_claims.factor: GPU time increases only moderately while CPU time rises sharply after 15 assets
speedup_claims.caveats: No numerical timing data reported in text; based on figure interpretation.
